basic_info.description:
Beautifully designed and appointed townhomes located in the center of the city. Ashbury Heights is literally “on top of the world”, with dramatic views of the city, ocean, Golden Gate Bridge, Bay, and Twin Peaks. Also in walking distance are Cole Valley, the Castro, and Golden Gate Park.

Each townhome is unique in its own way, offering a flexible floor plan, custom finishes, and dramatic San Francisco Views.

  • Spacious Open-Plan living Room and Dining Room
  • Oak Hardwood Floors, Ebony Stained in Living and Dining Room
  • Chefs Stainless Appliances Including Viking Gas Stove, Refrigerator/Freezer, and Dishwasher
  • Santa Margarita Stone Countertops, Custom Kitchen Dual Tone Cabinetry, with Under Cabinet Lighting
  • Stone Cast Gas Fireplace
  • Designer Baths Include Italian PORCELANOSA Tile, Cabinetry and Chrome Hardware. Master Bath Includes Separate Tub, Oversized Walk-In Rain Shower System and Full Glass Shower Enclosure
  • Soaring Ceiling Heights and Abundant Windows
  • Recessed Lighting Throughout
  • Custom Closet Organizers
  • Incredible San Francisco Views
  • Multiple Outdoor Decks and Private Garden
  • Spacious Garage with Additional Storage and Laundry Facilities

    Please visit: www.ModernInTheHeights.com
